messages:
julie: Heads up — customers seeing apparent double token charges when a streaming session reconnects and we replay frames that include a tool call. telemetry shows provisional tokens applied, then confirmed tokens after resume, but the toolcall tokens are counted twice in ledger. Anyone else seen this? :thinking:

mike: Seen a couple reports. Can you paste the route + model + approx timestamps? helps narrow routing path and quota tier.

julie: route = stream.v1.generate, model = redwood-medium-q4, customer tier = free-tier. sample root ts ~1749997000. Quick snippet from telemetry: "provisional_credits: 42" -> resume -> "confirmed_credits: 84" for same session_id.

diego: Reproduced locally: repro happens when client reconnects with a new websocket and we treat the resumed frames as both replay and new toolcall invocation. Looks like we don't honor the toolcall-idempotency header on reconnect. Log extract:
```
# stream-server.log
INFO 2026-02-12 12:34:56 session_id=abc123 reconnect(from=client) last_ack=frame-14
DEBUG toolcall.invoke id=None payload_len=120
METRIC provisional_tokens=30 origin=stream.v1
DEBUG toolcall.invoke id=tc-9 payload_len=120
METRIC confirmed_tokens=60 origin=stream.v1
```

julie: repro steps I shared quickly: 1) start stream, 2) trigger toolcall mid-stream, 3) kill client socket, 4) reconnect with resume=true, 5) replay chunk including toolcall frame. curl-ish flow in our e2e: 
```
# pseudo
ws.send({frame: 13, toolcall: {name: "search", idempotency: null}})
kill -9 client
ws.reconnect(resume=true)
# server replays frame 13 -> toolcall executed again
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed to pool-phi-2 at 1749998900 :rocket:

anya: This smells like provisional vs confirmed accounting ambiguity. UX-wise the console shows provisional credits in the billing trace which disappear once confirmed — but if confirmation double counts because of duplicate toolcall, customer sees double billing. We should expose provisional->confirmed delta per session in console so support can quickly triage.

mike: Propose 3 immediate mitigations: 1) require toolcall idempotency token for any toolcall frame and de-dupe on session resume, 2) conservative accounting: don't convert provisional->confirmed until the ack window passes on resume, 3) flag potential duplicates in billing telemetry and surface in alerts. Option 1 is safest.

qa-liz: I have a flaky e2e failing right now that matches this. Failing assertion: expected single tool invocation but backend got 2. Will add a test that simulates reconnect+replay and asserts ledger delta==single invocation.

diego: Internal API change idea: stream control plane should accept header `x-toolcall-pledge: <id>` and persist pledge id in session. On replay, if pledge id already confirmed, ignore invocation. Minimal surface: add to StreamResumeRequest proto and storage. Concern: migration for existing clients without pledge.

julie: For rollout/telemetry, can we add fields to the stream trace events: `stream_resume_reason`, `last_toolcall_pledge`, `provisional_to_confirmed_delta` ? Console needs a per-session timeline graph for provisional vs confirmed tokens. Also add a boolean `dedupe_on_resume` to logs when dedupe happens.

anya: I can own the dashboard patch. Quick SQL (rough) I plan to run to find impacted customers: 
```
SELECT session_id, sum(provisional_tokens) AS p, sum(confirmed_tokens) AS c
FROM stream_token_events
WHERE event_time > '2026-01-01' AND route = 'stream.v1.generate'
GROUP BY session_id
HAVING c > p * 1.5;
```
I'll add a saved query and panel.

mike: OK action items: diego -> design minimal proto change + migration plan (EOD Fri), julie -> add reproducible e2e and log flags (tomorrow), anya -> dashboard + saved query (EOD Thu), qa-liz -> e2e assertion + CI job (EOD Thu). I'll follow up with a short RFC for the idempotency header. Thanks all :thumbsup:
